Compatibility.heading: Compatibility check
Compatibility.intro: Checked automatically from the parts' specifications.
Compatibility.cpuSocketMismatch: The {cpu} processor does not fit the {motherboard} motherboard socket.
Compatibility.ramTypeMismatch: {ram} memory is not supported by this {motherboard} motherboard.
Compatibility.ramSlotsExceeded: {modules} memory modules do not fit in {slots} slots.
Compatibility.ramCapacityExceeded: {gb} GB of memory exceeds the motherboard maximum of {maxGb} GB.
Compatibility.caseFormFactorUnsupported: This case does not support a {motherboard} motherboard (supports: {supported}).
Compatibility.gpuTooLong: The graphics card ({gpuMm} mm) is longer than the case allows ({maxMm} mm).
Compatibility.coolerSocketUnsupported: The CPU cooler does not support the {cpu} socket.
Compatibility.radiatorUnsupported: The case does not support a {radiatorMm} mm radiator.
Compatibility.coolerTooTall: The CPU cooler ({coolerMm} mm) is taller than the case allows ({maxMm} mm).
Compatibility.coolerUnderRated: The CPU cooler is rated for {ratingW} W, below the processor's {cpuW} W.
Compatibility.psuFormFactorUnsupported: The case does not support a {psu} power supply.
Compatibility.psuInsufficient: The {psuW} W power supply is below the estimated {estimatedW} W draw.
Compatibility.psuBelowRecommended: The {psuW} W power supply is below the recommended {recommendedW} W.
Compatibility.m2SlotsExceeded: {drives} M.2 drives do not fit in {slots} motherboard slots.
Compatibility.unknownSpec: Could not verify one check because the specification "{spec}" is missing.

RecentlyViewed.title: Recently viewed
RecentlyViewed.lead: Products you looked at on this device.

common.footer: You received this email because this address was used at {brand}. If that wasn't you, you can ignore it.
common.automatic: This is an automatic message. Please don't reply to it with sensitive information.

verifyCode.subject: Your {brand} verification code
verifyCode.heading: Verify your email
verifyCode.intro: Enter this code to verify your email address at {brand}.
verifyCode.ignore: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {brand} password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {brand} account.
resetPassword.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
resetPassword.expires: The link expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {brand} password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password of your {brand} account was just changed.
passwordChanged.othersSignedOut: Your other signed-in devices were signed out. This device stayed signed in.
passwordChanged.wasntYou: If this wasn't you, reset your password now. Resetting it signs out every device.
passwordChanged.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
passwordChanged.itWasYou: If it was you, no action is needed.
passwordChanged.allSignedOut: Every device that was signed in to your account was signed out.
passwordChanged.wasntYouReset: If this wasn't you, someone may have access to your email inbox. Reset your password again and secure your email account.

test.subject: {brand} test email
test.heading: Test email
test.body: If you can read this, your email setup works.

accountExists.subject: Someone tried to register with your {brand} email
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.intro: Someone just tried to create a {brand} account with this email address, and an account already exists.
accountExists.action: If it was you, sign in instead, or use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page if you don't remember your password.
accountExists.ignore: If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing was changed.

emailChangeCode.subject: Your {brand} email confirmation code
emailChangeCode.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChangeCode.intro: A request was made to use this email address for a {brand} account. Enter this code in your account to confirm it:
emailChangeCode.expires: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
emailChangeCode.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.

emailChangeNotice.subject: An email change was requested on your {brand} account
emailChangeNotice.heading: Email change requested
emailChangeNotice.intro: Someone asked to change the email address of your {brand} account to {address}.
emailChangeNotice.wasntYou: If this wasn't you, cancel it now, then reset your password. Nothing changes until the code sent to the new address is entered.
emailChangeNotice.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
emailChangeNotice.itWasYou: If it was you, no action is needed. Finish the change in your account with the code sent to the new address.

emailChanged.subject: The email address of your {brand} account was changed
emailChanged.heading: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.intro: The email address of your {brand} account was changed to {address}. From now on, emails for this account go to that address, not this one.
emailChanged.othersSignedOut: Your other signed-in devices were signed out.
emailChanged.wasntYou: If this wasn't you, contact us right away so we can help you secure the account.
emailChanged.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
emailChanged.itWasYou: If it was you, no action is needed.

emailChangeTaken.subject: Someone asked to use your email for another {brand} account
emailChangeTaken.heading: This address already has an account
emailChangeTaken.intro: A request was made to use this email address for a different {brand} account, but an account with this address already exists, so nothing was changed.
emailChangeTaken.action: If you meant to use this account, sign in with this address. If you don't remember your password, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.
emailChangeTaken.ignore: If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Welcome back. Sign in to see your orders and saved items.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create your account
register.metaDescription: Create a {brand} account to order, track deliveries and save items.
register.intro: It takes a minute. We'll email you a 6-digit code to confirm your address.
register.termsPrefix: I have read and accept the
register.marketing: Send me news and offers by email (optional)

verify.title: Check your email
verify.metaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you.
verify.intro: If {email} is new here, we've sent it a 6-digit code. It is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you already have an account with this address, we've emailed you instead.
verify.resent: If that address needs a code, a new one is on its way.
verify.needEmail: Enter your email address to continue.
verify.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in
verify.expired: This verification has expired. Sign in to get a new code, or create your account again.
verify.codeHint: Digits only. You can paste the code from your email.

account.title: My account
account.signedInNote: You are signed in. Orders, addresses and wishlist arrive in later updates.

fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. You can use any language. A few random words work well.
fields.dateOfBirthHint: Format YYYY-MM-DD. You must be at least 16.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter an Egyptian mobile number like 01012345678
errors.invalid_name: Use letters only (spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are fine).
errors.invalid_dob: Enter a valid date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.too_young: You must be at least 16 to create an account.
errors.must_accept: You need to accept to continue.
errors.contains_null: This password contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.breached: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.expired_code: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.verification_expired: This verification has expired. Sign in to get a new code, or register again.
errors.same_password: Choose a password that is different from your current one.
errors.invalid_session: That device could not be found.
errors.current_session: Use Sign out to sign out of this device.
errors.try_again: Your password changed while this was happening. Please try again.
errors.same_email: That is already your email address.
errors.no_email_change: There's no email change in progress. Start again.
errors.email_unavailable: That address can't be used. Start again with a different address.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.metaDescription: Request a link to reset your password.
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password, if an account exists.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.metaDescription: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.intro: Pick a new password. Signing in elsewhere will be ended for your safety.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.

overview.name: Name
overview.profileBody: Your name, mobile number, date of birth and gender.
overview.securityBody: Change your password, see where you're signed in and review recent security activity.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Update your name, mobile number and other details.
profile.emailBody: This is where we send order and security emails. Changing it needs your password and a code sent to the new address.

security.title: Security
security.metaDescription: Change your password and manage where you're signed in.
security.intro: Change your password, see where you're signed in and review recent activity.

password.heading: Change password
password.intro: Changing your password signs you out of your other devices. This device stays signed in, and we email you a confirmation.
password.done: Your password was changed. Your other devices were signed out and we sent you a confirmation email.

sessions.heading: Where you're signed in
sessions.intro: These devices are signed in to your account. If you don't recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.times: Times are shown in Cairo time.
sessions.noOthers: You're not signed in anywhere else.
sessions.signedOutDevices: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in.} one {Signed out of # device.} other {Signed out of # devices.}}
sessions.alreadySignedOut: That device was already signed out.

activity.heading: Recent security activity
activity.intro: The latest sign-ins and security changes on your account. We keep this list for about 12 months. It doesn't include IP addresses.

email.title: Change email address
email.metaDescription: Change the email address of your account.
email.intro: Your email address is how you sign in and where we send order and security emails. Changing it needs your password. We send a code to the new address and tell your current address about the request.
email.pendingBody: If {address} can be used for this account, we've sent a 6-digit code there. It works until {time}, Cairo time. Check your spam folder too.
email.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}
email.resent: If the address can be used, we've sent a new code.
email.changed: Your email address was changed. Your other devices were signed out, and we told your previous address.
email.signInNote: From now on, sign in with your new address.

cancelEmailChange.title: Cancel the email change
cancelEmailChange.metaDescription: Cancel a request to change the email address of an account.
cancelEmailChange.intro: Someone asked to change the email address of a {brand} account. If that wasn't you, cancel it here. Nothing changes until the code sent to the new address is entered, so cancelling stops it.
cancelEmailChange.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.
cancelEmailChange.done: The email change was cancelled. The email address of the account has not changed.
cancelEmailChange.advice: If you didn't ask for it, someone may know your password. Reset it now; resetting signs out every device.
